name: Giant Steps
description: Clock-driven chord sequencer over Coltrane tonal center geometry

sections.heading: Faders
items: Main — approach density: bottom = centers only (3 chords), middle = V-I (6), top = full ii-V-I (9)

sections.heading: Signal / LEDs
items: Three tonal center hues: blue, green, orange — LED shows the current center
CV Out tracks root pitch of the current step
CV In Density modulates approach depth; CV In Reset triggers cycle reset on rising edge
Button ducks briefly on each chord trigger

channels.jackDescription: CV Out sends the root pitch of the current cycle step. CV In Density modulates the approach depth; CV In Reset triggers a cycle reset on rising edge.
channels.faderDescription: Approach depth: bottom = centers only (3 chords), middle = V-I (6), top = full ii-V-I (9 chords).
channels.faderPlusFnDescription: Live velocity override for all chord voices.
channels.fnDescription: Short tap resets the cycle to step 0.
channels.fnPlusShiftDescription: Hold toggles the reverse flag, inverting Forward/Reverse direction.
channels.ledTop: Current tonal center hue (blue / green / orange)
